address: 6 place de la République, Delme, 57590, France
bio: This has been the fiefdom of the François family since it was founded in 1954. After a worthwhile experience at the Bras family's Laguiole restaurant, Thomas (in the kitchen) and Laura, his charming partner (on the restaurant floor), have both returned to the fold in Delme. So it's now the third generation at the helm of this contemporary restaurant, which is popular with locals and visiting guests alike. The menu is both indulgent and delicate, oscillating between tradition and modernity, showcasing an appreciation for herbs and spices. Uplifting!...
